output.title: How to Be a Little Less Wrong, and a Little More Kind
output.excerpt: An essay about the two skills — thinking clearly and treating people well — that make almost everything else better. What kind of essay helps the most people? Before saying anything useful, it's worth being honest about the assignment itself. If the goal is to improve the world for the greatest…

summary: How to Be a Little Less Wrong, and a Little More Kind is an essay arguing that the greatest good comes from two universal skills rather than any single cause. It shows readers how to hold beliefs in proportion to the evidence, by seeking out critics and asking what would change their mind, and how to treat others as fully real, from assuming honest mistakes over malice to asking before accusing and forgiving.
